title: 1904 back under its memory lines, on a phone and a desktop
items: The 1904 town had grown past the memory line a phone is held to as Prairie Avenue's houses and coach houses filled in; it is back under it, about 35 MB lighter, with nothing taken out of the scene

On a desktop, 1904 had crept over its own line too; it is about 35 MB lighter, mostly by no longer keeping a second copy of the Glessner house's file for a Settings switch the browser's cache already answers
